name: Level_1 - Task_3
description: Construct a bulk conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Copper (Cu) using the experimental lattice parameter a = 3.615 Å. Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator. Generate 9 different system volumes by uniformly scaling the lattice parameter from -5% to +5% (scale factors from 0.95 to 1.05). Evaluate the total potential energy at each volume point using the MACE calculator, and fit the resulting Volume-Energy data to a Birch-Murnaghan equation of state. Return the calculated equilibrium bulk modulus as a float value in GPa units.
